blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) on Wednesday reiterated its warning against love scams, reporting over 700 complaints since the start of the year, averaging 70 per month. BOC Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno said the agency received the most complaints in January. He also said the scams are typically orchestrated by foreign nationals. He noted that fraudsters usually build romantic relationships with victims to gain their trust before luring them into sending money.
